entries.title: Micah 6:1
segments:
Arise, contend thou; addressed by God to the prophet. 
 
  Before the mountains--the hills; these are summoned as witnesses to the controversy.  See

entries.title: Micah 6:3
segments:
Wherein have I wearied thee? that thou shouldest forsake me. 
 
God's service is most reasonable excellent; when we grow weary in it, the fault is in our own hearts.

entries.title: Micah 6:4
segments: The remembrance of God's innumerable favors to us and our fathers in days past, ought to bind us to his service with the cords of love and gratitude.

entries.title: Micah 6:5
segments:
What Balaam--answered him; pronouncing, by my command, blessings, instead of the curses which he had been hired to utter. 
 
  From Shittim unto Gilgal; that is, on the way from Shittim unto Gilgal.  Shittim was the last station of the Israelites east of the Jordan,
; and Gilgal the first station west of it,

. 
 
  The righteousness of the Lord; as manifested in his faithfulness to his promises, notwithstanding your many provocations.

entries.title: Micah 6:6
segments:
Wherewith shall I come; the prophet rebukes the spirit of formality, and shows that God requires inward holiness and obedience. 
 
vv 6-8. 
 
God does not require us to purchase heaven for ourselves by costly gifts.  He asks only for himself a humble and broken heart, that gladly accepts the free salvation which he has provided for us through Christ; and for our fellow men a just and merciful spirit.  Where these are wanting, the most costly offerings and the most gorgeous rites are abominable in his sight.

entries.title: Micah 6:9
segments: To see and acknowledge God's hand in the afflictions which come upon us, is the mark of true wisdom.

entries.title: Micah 6:10
segments:
vv 10-11. 
 
Fraud in business is a common sin, and there is reason to fear that some practise it who wish to be thought pure and holy.  But the religion that carries in its hand a scant measure and deceitful balances, is alike abominable with God and men.

entries.title: Micah 6:12
segments:
Thereof; of Zion. 
 
vv 12-16. 
 
The prosperity of cities and nations is from God.  When they abuse it by making it the means of violence and fraud he will take it away, and all their labor and planning will end in disappointment.

entries.title: Micah 6:16
segments: Ye shall bear the reproach of my people; addressed to the rich and noble,
.  When God gives up his people to the reproach of captivity, they shall bear the heaviest part of the suffering.
